answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only stated path to the mandated 18% spend reduction before the non-auto-renewing contract expires. Prior evidence supports quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, but not delivery performance at 94% line utilization; verify that record and condition any primary transition on immediate delivery-capacity validation. The incumbent's stability benefit is recognized, but its refusal to reopen price makes renewal inconsistent with the finance mandate.
